title: Day32 VRRP read-only precheck profile
notes: This profile is only the data foundation for a future Day32 read-only precheck.
This profile does not mean the current runner supports Day32.
VRRP live configuration is not allowed.
Firewall, interface, and IP address modification is not allowed.
Reboot and reset configuration actions are not allowed.
Real device connection information must be loaded from local private config and must not be written to the repository.
